title: Contraction minima shift away from the trace frame near the center
alt_text: At the innermost fixed-memory sections, two sampled profiles have no strict minimum bracket and two have qualified minima shifted from their trace-frame origins. Left shows the conditional frame and section supports; right shows every measured sample and the two independent minima, with no lines joining minima.
selection: All four directed sections at the smallest planned longitudinal distance 0.0002, retaining every sample and failed/partial status. No outcome-based section selection.
metric: Scaled Euclidean coordinates: steering scale2.5e-6 and log10-temperature scale7.5e-6.
uncertainty: Black bars show final refinement brackets; these are not confidence intervals or certified exact-extremum enclosures.
limits: Finite sections at one refined memory setting; not continuous valley continuation.
No bracket excludes only strict brackets on the sampled mesh, not unsampled minima.
Trace-frame rays are conditional quadratic predictors, not measured contraction curves.
No exact trace zero, superstability or intrinsic valley connection is established.
